title: My BIL Forged My Signature, Sold $900K Franchise, Gave $5K. So I Let Him Wear 'Dependable Liar'
description: When my brother-in-law forged an ownership release to steal my $900K franchise and gave me a $5K severance, he didn't count on a notarized birthday card from my late husband. Now he changes bedpans in a 'Dependable Liar' scrub shirt at 'Careless Betrayal Senior Services,' where every welcome kit prints his fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #SeniorCareFranchise
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY NAME, NOW HE WEARS 'DEPENDABLE LIAR'
pinned_comment: If your brother-in-law forged your signature and stole a $900K franchise buyout, would you make him work in a 'Dependable Liar' scrub shirt? Share your story in the comments!
